title: Title of the warning before signing out with messages typed but not sent.
sign-out: Button in the warning before signing out with unsent drafts: signs out and clears them.
body: {{count}} is how many unsent drafts; {{places}} is a list of where they are (chat titles, or "a new chat with Ada").
more: The last item in that list, for the places not named.
place.untitled: In the list of where unsent drafts are: a chat that has no title yet.
place.new-chat: Where a draft is: the new-chat box of a socio (AI agent). {{socio}} is its name. Lowercase: it goes inside a sentence.
place.unknown: Where a draft is, when the chat isn't known. Lowercase: it goes inside a sentence.
leave-page-draft: Browser confirmation when leaving a page being edited with unsaved changes.
